primary.summary: HDFC AMC's board will meet on July 15, 2026, to review financial results for June 2026. The trading window for shares closes from July 1-17, 2026. The firm launched a new sustainable investment strategy, HDFC Growth for GOOD Portfolio, aiming for positive societal outcomes.
